page.content:
Older fermented fish-and-rice preservation that predates Edo nigiri.

How Narezushi connects

  • Topic: Sushi — Fermented narezushi preceded vinegar-seasoned Edo sushi as the older form.
  • Artifact: Funazushi — Funazushi is a living Shiga example of narezushi.

What is Narezushi?

Narezushi, still made as funazushi in Shiga, is the lactic-fermented ancestor: rice was once discarded after curing the fish. Edo street sushi sped that idea into a meal.

Key threads lead to Sushi and Funazushi.
